verdict.rationale: Expensify's own travel page documents in-platform booking of flights, hotels, cars, and rail as part of a corporate travel management solution. Nothing in the evidence shows travel policy being enforced at booking time, which is the core differentiator of this story. Missing for 10: documented travel-policy enforcement at booking time (e.g., out-of-policy blocking or approval before purchase), in-depth booking docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an employee, I can book flights and hotels in-platform with travel policy applied at booking time, not expensed and argued about later

citations.quote: Expensify's corporate travel management solution means business trips don't end in a pile of receipts.
